[P2] Match casing guidance to the configured Athena table

Existing explorer-created tables retain their old SerDe settings: `onEnsureAthenaTable()` returns when the table exists, and the DDL uses `CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS`. Updating the explorer or MCP server nevertheless switches this guidance immediately, so generated camelCase paths return NULL and filters silently omit matching records until users perform the documented manual migration. Detect the table's SerDe settings and select compatible guidance, or verify migration before applying the new guidance. Add regression coverage for an existing table.
